limits: operator new is a native heap allocation stand-in.
operator delete is a native heap release stand-in.
realloc is a scripted native CRT boundary; cases preserve copied bytes and allocation lifetime.
lstrlenA is a scripted Windows string-length boundary.
InterlockedDecrement is a scripted Windows atomic decrement boundary.
Only the eleven registration entries are owned; callback bodies, parent registrations outside the owned set, constructors and virtual tables retain their existing owners.

Original growth failure faults in its saved-EBP diagnostic read before returning; the listed normal-return continuations are unreachable and their fault outcomes are outside ordinary comparison coverage.
The read-only registry core bridge is linked as an auxiliary source; its separately owned entries are not added to this family.
notes: Every seed has a plain RET, no incoming stack operands or live incoming ECX, and no consumed result: cdecl0/void. Registrations reuse the existing typed registry core. The owned 0x47dc30 parent call to owned 0x474060 stays native. Other original callees remain whole code; diagnostics use the core compiler-context contracts. Callback addresses are registration data only.
